title: Property Types Reference
description: Complete reference of property types, operators, and validation rules

steps.title: Primitive Types
steps.description: String, Number, Boolean, Date, URL, Email, Color - each with type-specific validation

steps.title: Operators by Type
steps.description: String: =, !=, contains, startsWith, endsWith, regex | Number: =, !=, >, <, >=, <= | Date: =, !=, before, after, between | Boolean: =, !=

steps.title: Special Properties
steps.description: status (enum), priority (enum), dueDate (date), location (geo), tags (array), assignee (pubkey)

steps.title: Computed Properties
steps.description: Define properties that auto-calculate from other properties (e.g., overdue = dueDate < now && status != done)

steps.title: Property Constraints
steps.description: Set required, unique, min/max length, min/max value, pattern, and custom validators per property

steps.title: View Property Schema
steps.description: Open Command Palette → 'Help: Property Types Reference' for the full interactive table
